clip_t_prompt_alignment.reason: Frozen verifier v1.2 architecture implements CLIP for discrete semantic prop detection and solarization/inversion probing; continuous cosine similarity between full prompt text and image tokens was not part of the frozen verifier pipeline.

diversity_and_copy_paste_flag.reason: No copy-paste detector or perceptual hash pairwise image distance module was pre-registered or executed during TEST-3 generation.

stress_scene.reason: 3-character stress scenes (Story A Scene 6, Story B Scene 4, Story C Scene 5) were pre-registered to run after primary replicates; execution was halted at 8.029h by the pre-declared 8.0h cap stopping rule.

detector_independence.independence_assessment: Independent. Face recall (1.0000, 174/174 face slots detected) was audited out-of-loop using DeepFace's RetinaFace detector, completely isolated from the generation pipeline's in-loop InsightFace buffalo_l detector.

in_loop_anchor_similarity.metric: InsightFace buffalo_l cosine similarity to certified anchor
in_loop_anchor_similarity.interpretation: Measures fine-grained geometric likeness between a rendered face in a complex scene and the standalone certified anchor portrait. The low value (0.2412) reflects facial expression variations, head yaw/pitch, distance scaling, and lighting differences relative to the neutral anchor portrait.

out_of_loop_cross_scene_identity.metric: 4-Judge Ensemble (Facenet512, SFace, GhostFaceNet, ArcFace) AUC & Rank-1
out_of_loop_cross_scene_identity.interpretation: Measures whether faces of the same character across different narrative scenes and replicates are distinguishable from impostors. The high values (AUC 0.9578, Rank-1 95.56%) demonstrate that characters remain recognizable as themselves across diverse story contexts even though scene renderings drift geometrically from the static anchor crop.
